subject: Mutual Action Plan: commit sizing & credit request for Fidelis Health
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@fidelis.health>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + draft MAP (next steps & target close)

Hi Laura — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Target close: customer PO by 2026-06-18 (you mentioned procurement aiming for early June)
- Proposed commit: $250k first-year committed usage (discount tiers below)
- Key milestones (draft MAP attached):
  • Week 1 (5/10): finalize legal/PO template (Procurement)
  • Week 2 (5/17): security questionnaire handoff & SOC 2 evidence (Fidelis + Redwood Sec)
  • Week 3 (5/24): pilot kickoff / integration test (Fidelis eng + Redwood onboarding)
  • Week 6 (6/14): production cutover & billing start
- Dependencies: procurement PO, completion of security checklist, SSO + VPC networking approvals

Attached: MAP_v1_FidelisHealth.xlsx (milestones, owners, target dates). Can you confirm: (1) procurement timeline; (2) whether a 12‑month commit is required from your side; (3) if Fidelis needs a named‑customer SLA addendum?

Also flagging to my manager and GTM lead (cc) that this may require a pricing exception — Laura indicated they're evaluating other vendors and asked if we can consider a one‑time credit to offset migration costs. Ben / Vivek — can you please review the attached MAP and advise on the credit/discount leash so I can respond to Laura by EOD Monday?

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0142

Attachment: MAP_v1_FidelisHealth.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@fidelis.health>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@fidelis.health>, Procurement <procurement@fidelis.health>
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + draft MAP (next steps & target close)

Thanks Soojin — that recap looks right. A few clarifications from procurement and product: 

- Procurement timeline: we need a signed PO by 2026-06-10 to make June billing. Our internal legal turn is ~2 weeks if no redlines.
- Commit sizing: product prefers a 12 month commit. For budget we are targeting $200k-$300k first year; can you confirm number-level options (e.g., $150k/$250k/$400k commits and associated discounts)?
- Credits: we asked about a one-time migration credit (Laura note: to cover connectors + integration testing). Ideally something in the $30k–$50k range or a steeper T1 discount for year-1.

Security & SSO: Marco will send the network diagram + person responsible for security questionnaire next week.

Please include the commit/discount options in the MAP and indicate which items require exec approval. Procurement will need to see a final MAP and PO language.

—Laura
VP Product, Fidelis Health
laura.chen@fidelis.health

Attachment: Fidelis-RFP-overview.pdf (referenced)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@fidelis.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP v2 + pricing options (for procurement viewing)

Laura — thanks. I've attached a cleaned-up MAP (MAP_v2_FidelisHealth.pdf) that includes three commit tiers and the corresponding pricing/credits. Summary below: 

Tier A: $150k 12-mo commit — 10% list discount, no onboarding credit
Tier B: $250k 12-mo commit — 20% list discount, $30k one-time onboarding credit (applied as billing credit in month 2)
Tier C: $400k 12-mo commit — 30% list discount, $50k onboarding credit + two free engineering consulting days

I've labeled the items that will need exec approval for pricing/credits (Tier B and Tier C discounts & credits are exception territory). Procurement-friendly PO language is included as an appendix.

HubSpot deal link and MAP: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1873 
Attachment: MAP_v2_FidelisHealth.pdf (7 pages)

If that looks good, I'll escalate the Tier B credit request to leadership for a final decision — would you prefer we aim for Tier B (your earlier signal) or leave Tier C as a stretch?

Thanks,
Soojin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com

Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: URGENT: pricing exception request for Fidelis — need decision by EOD Wed (5/12)

Ben / Vivek — forwarding the customer MAP and Laura's ask. Key ask: Fidelis is signaling Tier B ($250k commit) but has requested a $30k onboarding credit (or alternatively a 30% year‑1 discount). I recommended Tier B (20% + $30k credit) as our baseline to keep ACV economics intact, but they explicitly asked for the 30% option as a comparison to competitor pricing. 

Why approve: strategic healthcare account with published reference potential; opportunity to expand to Dedicated capacity in 9–12 months (high upside). Risk: credit reduces first-year revenue recognition; we should make credit conditional on 12‑month commit and PO in by 6/10.

Proposal for exec decision: 
- Option 1 (approved by default): Tier B — 20% discount + $30k one-time credit if PO signed by 2026-06-10 and 12‑month term (no further approval required).
- Option 2 (stretch, needs leadership sign-off): Tier C — 30% + $50k credit + 2 consulting days (requires VP approval).

Requested: Vivek, can you sign off on Option 1 or request escalation to Option 2? Need a reply by EOD Wednesday 2026-05-12 to meet procurement timeline.

Attachments: MAP_v2_FidelisHealth.pdf, pricing-summary-Fidelis-0509.csv

Thanks,
Soojin

Subject: Re: URGENT: pricing exception request for Fidelis — need decision by EOD Wed (5/12)

Folks — read the MAP and the rationale. I approve a constrained exception: approve Option 1 with a tweak.

Decision: approve Tier B but change onboarding credit to $30k split: $20k applied as one-time billing credit and $10k held as a rebate payable after production cutover (to ensure they hit cutover milestones). Approve the 20% discount for year-1.

Conditions:
- PO must be received and countersigned by 2026-06-10.
- 12-month commitment must be explicit in the SOW.
- Add a performance SLO clause summary in the MAP (uptime & latency targets) — include rollback/fallback language if we miss SLO during first 60 days.

Ben: confirm we communicate the updated Tier B terms to Laura and update MAP_v2 to show the split credit structure and the SLO language. After you confirm back to me, Soojin can share the final MAP to procurement and trigger legal review.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
